interface.signature: A: int, Y: int, X: int -> int

preconditions.description: A, Y, and X are integers within the given constraints.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max(0, (A // Y) * X + min(A % Y + 1, X))
postconditions.description: The result is the maximum number of lit candles at time A, computed as the sum of fully completed cycles of Y seconds (each contributing X candles) plus the candles lit in the current partial cycle (up to X).
